visual.description: Primary white background — the universal field for data-dense layouts.
Very light blue-grey used for alternate section backgrounds and card surfaces.
Slightly tinted surface for stat cards, code backgrounds, and data panels.
Deep navy used for all primary headings and the logo wordmark.
Dark slate for body copy and paragraph text — readable without being harsh.
Medium slate-blue for secondary labels, captions, and subdued data labels.
Light slate for placeholder text and de-emphasized metadata.
Crisp blue accent — primary action color, active states, and data highlights.
Deeper blue for button hover states and pressed actions.
Very light blue tint for tag backgrounds, focus rings, and active row fills.
Faintest blue surface for highlighted rows and selected states.
Light neutral border for card containers, table rows, and dividers.
Stronger border for interactive elements and focused inputs.
Near-black for the dark CTA section and footer.
Dark blue-grey surface for elements within the dark section.
Emerald green for positive metric indicators and status badges.
Red for negative metric indicators and error states.
Amber for warning indicators and cautionary data states.
White navigation background — filled, not transparent.
Deep navy for nav link text.
